top_choice_rationale: Circuit QED established an experimentally controllable light–matter regime, a foundational physics achievement with a long record of reproducibility across laboratories. I rank it ahead of the mature optical lattice clock achievement while keeping the citation focused on the foundational circuit-QED work rather than later quantum-computing advances.
